title: chat-server: CustomEmoji/set overQuota for per-Space count and per-image size caps
description: jmap-chat-implementer-guide.md:466: "The server MUST reject CustomEmoji/set with overQuota (per RFC8620 §5.3) when the count or size limit is exceeded." emoji.rs create path has no count/size check; ChatLimits has no emoji caps. Size M. From audit JMAP-x3lu (docs/audits/2026-11-19-x3lu/, jmap-chat-spec 120db2c).
